title: Combat Engineers Get Savvy with Grenade Launchers
description: Combat engineers with Marine Wing Support Squadron 371, stationed out of Marine Corps Air Station Yuma, Ariz., took part in a field training exercise on July 30 - in which they fired rounds from the M203, M32, and MK19 grenade launchers.
